items.criterion: The mean of the seven per-class recalls clears the published bar and maps through the ramp.
items.evidence: submitted_artifact; recorded by tests/test_output.py check balanced_accuracy_ramp
items.judgment: EFFECT: balanced accuracy over the 87153 private graded rows, mapped through the floor-to-knee ramp published in tests/constants.json. UNMEASURED AT PHASE 0 - floor, knee and dichotomizing_threshold are null, so this check raises ConstantUnmeasured instead of returning a score, the verifier reports r_det null rather than 0.0, and the slot is not gradeable until the Phase 2 wave measures them on the grading host. The seven per-class recalls ARE computed and recorded as evidence while the ramp is unmeasured, so the rare-class collapse is visible in the record today.

items.criterion: Every entry is an integer cover-type label inside the declared domain.
items.evidence: submitted_artifact; recorded by tests/test_output.py check cover_type_domain
items.judgment: EFFECT: the dtype is an integer kind and every value lies in the closed interval 0 through 6; a float array, a one-hot matrix, a probability vector or a label outside the domain fails with reason label_domain_violation.

items.criterion: The label array carries exactly one row per graded feature row, in graded order.
items.evidence: submitted_artifact; recorded by tests/test_output.py check graded_row_alignment
items.judgment: EFFECT: the array is 1-D of length exactly 87153, matching environment/data/graded_features.npz row for row; 87151 rows, the length of the public validation fold, fails with reason wrong_fold_length, and no submission is trimmed or padded to fit.

items.criterion: The graded run leaves a loadable dense label array at the declared submission path.
items.evidence: submitted_artifact; recorded by tests/test_output.py check label_vector_lands
items.judgment: EFFECT: /submission/preds_c8s4.npy exists and loads through numpy with allow_pickle false; an object dtype, a pickled payload or an unreadable file fails with reason submission_unloadable.

items.criterion: The graded run neither writes into the checker tree nor reads the private labels.
items.evidence: submitted_source; recorded by tests/test_output.py check private_fold_boundary
items.judgment: EFFECT: the run record's guarded_paths_touched list is empty, and no path under tests/, no path naming graded_labels, and no verifier output directory appears in it; a non-empty list fails with reason red_line_crossed and names the paths.

items.criterion: The submitted array reproduces byte-for-byte from the recorded seed.
items.evidence: submitted_source; recorded by tests/test_output.py check seed_replay_identity
items.judgment: EFFECT: the sha256 of the delivered array equals the replay_sha256 the run record carries from the agent's own second run under its recorded seed; an absent replay digest fails with reason replay_unavailable and a differing one with reason replay_diverged.

items.criterion: The agent declares a leaf budget that multiplies out and lands under the authored cap.
items.evidence: run_record; recorded by tests/test_output.py check split_budget_declared
items.judgment: EFFECT: the run record's split_budget_declaration carries integer boosting_rounds, trees_per_round, leaves_per_tree, total_trees and total_leaves; total_trees equals boosting_rounds times trees_per_round, total_leaves equals total_trees times leaves_per_tree, and total_leaves is at most 84000. A declaration whose own factors disagree fails with reason declaration_inconsistent, and one over the cap fails with reason budget_overspent.
